commitMessage:
Fixed bug 312159: [rulers] Color blindness issue with red and gray Xs
for markers in vertical ruler
dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.image.sharedimagestopluginimages>
<!description: Replace PlatformUI shared images for error, warning, and info with internal JavaPluginImages alternatives to improve color accessibility.>
<!severity: WARNING>

<!map IMAGE_REPLACEMENT: "org.eclipse.ui.ISharedImages.IMG_OBJS_ERROR_TSK" => "org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaPluginImages.IMG_OBJS_ERROR_ALT", "org.eclipse.ui.ISharedImages.IMG_OBJS_WARN_TSK" => "org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaPluginImages.IMG_OBJS_WARNING_ALT", "org.eclipse.ui.ISharedImages.IMG_OBJS_INFO_TSK" => "org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaPluginImages.IMG_OBJS_INFO_ALT">

org.eclipse.ui.PlatformUI.getWorkbench().getSharedImages().getImage(#{IMAGE_REPLACEMENT})
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaPluginImages.get(#{IMAGE_REPLACEMENT_VALUE})
;;
summary: Replaces specific Eclipse shared images with internal JavaPluginImages equivalents.

commitMessage:
Bug 276467: [quick assist] Extract local variable extracts only one term
when part of a sum is selected
summary: The commit changes arguments passed to `ExtractTempRefactoring` and `ExtractConstantRefactoring` constructors, replacing `expression.getStartPosition()` with `context.getSelectionOffset()` and `expression.getLength()` with `context.getSelectionLength()`. While a local change, the replacement relies on the `context` variable which is not part of the matched sub-expression and thus cannot be bound by the pattern, making it unexpressible in the current DSL.
